Card.Name: Enable Windows Long Paths for Python Workflows
Card.Description: Some Python environments fail on Windows when project folders get very deep. Enabling Windows long paths removes the old 260-character path limit for compatible applications, including Python workflows that rely on the operating system long-path setting.
Card.FriendlyDescription: Some Python environments fail on Windows when project folders get very deep. Enabling Windows long paths removes the old 260-character path limit for compatible applications, including Python workflows that rely on the operating system long-path setting.
Card.WhatWeKnowSummary: Claim: Some Python environments fail on Windows when project folders get very deep. Enabling Windows long paths removes the old 260-character path limit for compatible applications, including Python workflows that rely on the operating system long-path setting. Evidence: Python's official Windows documentation directly names LongPathsEnabled under the FileSystem key as the control to enable when long path limits are the problem.
